endpointName: Valley City National Fish Hatchery launch
rationale: USFWS, Valley City Parks, and the Sheyenne River Water Trail identify the hatchery as a launch or hand-launch landing. Retain the stored point as a conditional federal-facility/access-area anchor; the 315-foot named-flowline offset reflects the facility, road, and shoreline footprint.
condition: Confirm current USFWS hatchery visitor access, launch permission, parking, carry path, river level, dam hazards, and event or seasonal restrictions before launching.
